abstract: Newsroom and civil-society training across the continent.
body_html:
We run verification training for newsrooms, civil-society organisations and universities, in the languages our desks publish in. Courses cover source discovery, image and video verification, and reading public finance documents.

  • Open newsroom cohorts
  • Bespoke desk training
  • University partnerships

Sessions are delivered in person and online, and materials stay available to participants afterwards.
